summary: Bank Nifty swung +700 then -1000 intraday; Nifty -325 from high. FIIs sold 6,645 crore (highest in months); crude $117 vs $150-in-2008 comparison (rupee much weaker now). Everything turning against India: crude, gold, FII selling, rupee.

events.claim: FIIs sold 6,645 crore on 3 Mar 2022, highest single-day selling in ~5-6 months; 11,000 crore in first two sessions of March
Brent crude hit $117, costlier in INR terms than the 2008 peak of $150 because USD/INR was ~40 then vs ~76 now
French President Macron spoke to Putin over 90 minutes as diplomatic channels stayed open

lessons: Markets can absorb good or bad news but not uncertainty; 8 days of war with no resolution keeps sellers in control.
quote: Markets can take positive things, can take negative things, but cannot take uncertainty.

summary: Overnight nuclear-plant shelling scare: Dow futures -600 then recovery to -200; SGX near 16,000 (800-point swings). Swing low 16,200 broken in SGX. Iran-crude talks as counter to Russian sanctions. Events ahead: Mar 7 exit polls, Mar 10 results, Mar 15-16 Fed.

events.claim: Russians shelled Europe's largest nuclear power plant in Ukraine (supplies ~1/4 of Ukraine's electricity); reports later said shelling stopped, no radiation rise
US expedited talks with Iran to bring Iranian crude to market as counterweight to Russian supply
Event cluster: 5-state election exit polls Mar 7, results Mar 10, US Fed meeting Mar 15-16, 2022

lessons: In wartime, headline news cannot be taken at face value; markets react violently to unverified headlines both ways.
Personal rule: stay out of the market until India VIX falls below 25; above 30 reduce positions.
quote: The war is first fought in the minds of the people, then only it is fought in the battlefield.

summary: Bank Nifty -1000 intraday after prior day's +700; two-day swing ~4,000 points (>10% of banking assets). Auto worst hit (crude, chip inputs like palladium from Russia). FIIs sold 7,631 crore; 3-day selling 18,500 crore - first time above 15,000 crore in 3 days (prior record 14,000 crore in COVID peak).

events.claim: Three consecutive days of FII selling of 18,500 crore - highest ever 3-day block, exceeding the COVID-peak record of ~14,000 crore
Bank Nifty fell from ~42,000 October high to ~32,000, about 25%
Italy down 12% and Germany's DAX down ~9.5% in one war week; Russian market closed so showed 'best' performance
Indian rupee crossed 76 per USD

lessons: When daily swings exceed 10% of an index's sector assets, position size must shrink, conviction notwithstanding.
Don't catch falling knives; wait for FII selling to subside and the 200-DMA (~16,900) to be reclaimed before investing.
quote: The last three trading sessions... 18,500 crore - the first time FIIs sold more than 15,000 crore in three days.

summary: Crude touched $130 on planned Russian-oil sanctions; Russia cut gas to Europe; gold $2,000. Poland's plan to send MiG jets to Ukraine (vs F-16s) threatened escalation. He publicly turned bear; feared a downside circuit like Lehman/COVID after 15-20% falls. Exit polls due evening.

events.claim: Brent crude touched $130 as the US moved to sanction Russian crude; Russia had cut natural gas supplies to Europe
Gold touched $2,000 during the war phase
Poland proposed transferring Russian-made MiG fighter jets to Ukraine in exchange for US F-16s
No Indian party has ruled for more than two consecutive terms in 40-50 years, feeding third-term uncertainty ahead of UP results

lessons: After 15-20% falls in past crises (Lehman, COVID) came one-way down-circuits; longs must survive that scenario, not just daily volatility.
When everything aligns bearish (crude, gold, flows, currency), book losses on late shorts rather than add - 'part and parcel of trading'.
quote: I have seen Lehman Brothers collapse and coronavirus - in both cases after the market fell 15-20% there was one down circuit.

summary: Bank Nifty fell ~2,000 points (4,500 in two invasion-linked sessions), breaking the 34,000 multiple support; October high 42,000 → ~32,000. ICICI/HDFC ADRs -4% flagged it pre-open. Turkey FM meeting news triggered short covering; DII fought in the last 45 minutes. Exit polls due 7pm.

events.claim: Bank Nifty fell 4,500 points across Feb 24 invasion day and Mar 7, 2022
Russia-Ukraine foreign ministers scheduled to meet in Turkey (Thursday); earlier Belarus talks
HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank ADRs fell ~4% overnight, presaging Bank Nifty's 5% fall

lessons: A 4% overnight fall in ADRs of banks that are ~half the index is a reliable gap-down tell for Bank Nifty.
Not every waterfall decline is capitulation - capitulation needs sellers exhausted, not just buyers frozen.
quote: Retail people thought the market moves only in one direction... now they are seeing the ugly face of the stock market.
leaks: sponsored by PhiPisar.com and Delta Dot Exchange (ASR garbles)

summary: Worst US fall of 2022; Nasdaq -20% from high (official bear market), S&P -15%, Dow -11/12%. Exit polls: comfortable BJP UP win. FII March selling already 25,000 crore in ~a week; record month 65,000 crore (Mar 2020) set to break. HDFC Bank ADR -5% daily. He bought puts on intraday recoveries via strategies.

FIIs sold ~25,000 crore in first ~5 sessions of March 2022; all-time record month was 65,000 crore (March 2020)
5-state exit polls indicated comfortable BJP win in Uttar Pradesh; UP ~75% seat share last time
HDFC Bank ADR fell ~5% repeatedly; ICICI Bank ADR -6% overnight

lessons: Track the trend of institutional selling (escalating monthly totals), not just the daily print - escalation signals no floor yet.
When daily low-breaks meet 200-250-point intraday recoveries, sell into recoveries or hedge portfolios with shorts; naked longs are the worst position.
quote: Every day previous day's low is broken and every day a 200 to 250 point intraday recovery happens.

summary: Despite FIIs selling 8,142 crore, market moved gradually, closed green after five red days: Europe's open flipped Dow futures -300→+250, sparking a last-two-hour Bank Nifty +1,000 short-covering rally; Nifty +350 from low. March FII total 34,000+ crore in 5 sessions. VIX still >28.

events.claim: FIIs sold 8,142 crore on 8 Mar; ~34,000 crore in first five sessions of March 2022 (~7,000 crore/day)
Nifty closed green for the first day after five consecutive losses; rally was broad-based, all sectors green except metals
Bank Nifty daily swings exceeded 1,000 points repeatedly; 2,500-point-away options traded >50 rupees

lessons: Gradual price movement despite heavy FII selling signals organic demand beneath the tape - a stabilizing marker.
Far-OTM option premiums balloon in panic regimes; patient far-strike selling monetizes fear but must respect expiry-day gap risk (Feb 24 precedent).
quote: Market moving gradually is always good for everyone.

summary: US/UK banned Russian oil; ceasefire corridors opened; Zelensky signalled no NATO membership and eastern-regions autonomy; Russia demanded Crimea recognition. HDFC Bank ADR -20% in days, premium over India price collapsed to 2-3%. SEBI approved LIC IPO - feared $9-10bn liquidity suction. He turned 'a little bullish' above 16,000.

events.claim: US and UK announced bans on Russian oil/energy imports; EU (Germany ~50% gas from Russia) not in favour
Zelensky signalled dropping NATO membership push and recognising eastern breakaway regions; Russia demanded Crimea recognition
SEBI approved LIC IPO; expected to raise ~$9-10 billion, seen as liquidity suction for secondary market
HDFC Bank ADR fell ~20% in 4-5 sessions; its premium over the India-listed share narrowed to 2-3% from 10-15%
ONGC OFS (UPA era): ~40,000 crore issue drew under 1,000 crore; LIC subscribed the remaining ~39,000 crore

lessons: Natural gas fell 4-5% on war headlines because Europe's dependence forces eventual compromise - price front-runs diplomacy.
Government issuances (LIC IPO) act as liquidity sumps; size them into your liquidity outlook before they hit.
quote: Markets cannot keep on falling... when 50% of stocks have fallen there must be some buying.

summary: Fantastic rally: Nifty 15,700→16,400+ (+700) as Zelensky's NATO climbdown, Russian 'not overthrowing government' line, halted Poland jet transfer, and ceasefire corridors aligned. events.claim: Nifty rallied ~700 points intraday on 9 Mar 2022 from 15,700 to above 16,400
Zelensky signalled no NATO membership and autonomy for eastern regions; Russia said its aim was not to overthrow Ukraine's government
US rejected Poland's MiG-to-Ukraine transfer plan, removing an escalation risk
FIIs sold 4,818 crore on 9 Mar; March total ~34-39,000 crore tracking past the all-time 65,000-crore month
LIC IPO dates announced: issue Mar 10-14, 2022

lessons: When the last bull turns bear, markets bottom - his own public bearish turn preceded the relief rally by a day.
Opening 180-200 points above SGX with no news = domestic quasi-sovereign support absorbing supply; watch who buys, not just what rises.
quote: When the last bull turns into a bear, the markets bottom out.

summary: Global relief rally: Germany +8%; UAE agreed to raise crude output; Brent 130→110-111. Reliance +5.5% on GRM ~$16 vs $10 (potential +60% refining profitability) but OI fell 3% - short covering, not fresh longs. Nov-2018 parallel: BJP lost 5 state elections then FIIs sold Nov 21 2018-Feb 2019. UP results today.

events.claim: UAE agreed to increase crude output; Brent fell from $130 to $110-111 by 10 Mar 2022
Singapore GRM ~$16/bbl vs ~$10 at Reliance's last results, implying ~60% higher refining profitability
Nov 2018: BJP lost all five state elections; FIIs sold aggressively Nov 21, 2018 to end-Feb 2019
Germany's DAX rose ~8% on 9 Mar 2022 relief rally

lessons: Price up + OI down = short covering, not fresh conviction - do not extrapolate such moves.
Read-through trades (Singapore GRM → Reliance margins) work only when the market has risk appetite to price them.
quote: When the price goes up and open interest goes down, that means it is a short covering, nothing else.

summary: Election-day pattern: strong first half, sold in the second. Nifty 15,700→16,750 in two sessions (+1,050), Bank Nifty +3,000; afternoon sell-off (-300/-1,000) met renewed short covering - a FII-vs-DII fight. BJP won 4 of 5 states incl. UP (30-40 seats fewer). Turkey FM talks yielded nothing; US CPI 7.9% (40-yr high) due.

events.claim: BJP won 4 of 5 state elections (UP retained, ~30-40 seats fewer); AAP won Punjab
Nifty +1,050 points in two sessions (15,700→16,750) around the election results
US CPI expected ~7.9%, a 40-50 year high, published 10 Mar 2022; Fed meeting the following week
Russia-Ukraine foreign ministers met in Turkey on 10 Mar 2022 with no breakthrough

lessons: Election-day tape has a shape: conviction rallies into results get sold once uncertainty resolves - fade the first-half euphoria on result days.
Bear-market rallies are fast, uniform, and sold into - the +8% Germany day was half-given-back within 24 hours.
quote: Throughout the morning I was happy because India VIX fell below 25 - but at the end of the day it closed above.

summary: US CPI 7.9% as expected but core CPI 6.4% vs 5.9% expected; US VIX fell 8% in a falling market - downside-risk signal. Fed 25bp hike now factored. FIIs sold only 1,980 crore. Huge ATM put writing at 16,500; puts sold more than calls. Adani Enterprises +10% post-results. HDFC FII holding 72%; FIIs short futures instead of selling cash (FII-limit ban fear).

events.claim: US Feb-2022 CPI printed 7.9% (as expected); core CPI 6.4% vs 5.9% expected
US VIX fell ~8% in a falling market on 10 Mar 2022 - read as limited downside risk
Fed expected to hike 25bp (below feared 50bp), Chair Powell having pre-signalled it
Massive open-interest build at 16,500 put (ATM) on 10-11 Mar 2022
SEBI rule: FIIs can short futures up to 500 crore plus equivalent of cash-market holdings; FII-buy-banned stocks (e.g. HDFC Bank) force futures-based selling

lessons: Falling VIX on a red day is a floor signal: fear is deflating even as price dips.
ATM put writing into a crash is informed-money positioning - sellers' strike-minus-premium math defines real support.
FII buy-bans convert cash selling into futures shorts; ADR/Cash/Futures triangulation explains 'who is selling what'.
quote: The parrot in my house has become alive now because the VIX has gone down.

summary: Consolidation day: DIIs arrested every fall, Nifty crossed 16,700 intraday, closed +35/+70. HDFC twins (~15% weight) alone caused the volatility as ADR-vs-cash divergences baited shorts. Putin's 'positive shifts in talks' comment sent Europe +3%, Dow futures +700 then -250 from high. ITC +15% in two weeks; high-dividend yielders led defensive rotation.

events.claim: Putin said there were 'positive shifts' in Russia-Ukraine talks (11 Mar 2022), lifting European markets ~3% before fading
ITC rose ~15% in two weeks (below 210 to 236); high-dividend-yield stocks outperformed in the drawdown
HDFC + HDFC Bank carry ~15% Nifty weight; their ADR-vs-India divergence drove index whipsaws

lessons: Market orders in whipsaw regimes leak real money (20,000→17,000 profit slippage) - use limits even to exit winners.
High-dividend-yield stocks are the classic drawdown hiding place; their outperformance flags a defensive, not risk-on, tape.
Unilateral peace headlines from one side produce gap-ups that fade - trade the confirmation, not the announcement.
quote: This kind of comment from one side... huge gap up, huge gap down - this is how traders are killed.

Monday pre-market timing change to 7:50 (channel housekeeping)

RBI quietly removed all HDFC Bank restrictions; government deferred petrol hike despite $100-120 crude - evidence of deliberate market support. FIIs down ~3 lakh crore (~6%) in FY22. Rule: don't fight the government.

events.claim: Hang Seng broke below 20,000, one-third below its 30,000+ level of months earlier - worst major market after Russia
RBI removed all restrictions on HDFC Bank (imposed on IT/infrastructure grounds) without public explanation, aiding sentiment
Petrol prices held despite crude rising from $60-70 to $100-120 - government absorbing the hit to avoid inflation optics
FIIs sold ~3 lakh crore of their ~48 lakh crore India holdings (~6%) in FY2021-22
A Chinese city of ~17 million went into COVID lockdown amid a fourth wave

lessons: When policy visibly defends the market (regulatory relief, deferred fuel hikes, pre-open buying above SGX), do not short the government.
SGX opens above indicated levels for consecutive days = persistent domestic bid; flows, not news, set the short-term floor.
quote: There is a famous saying in the US: don't fight the Fed. Here also, do not fight the government.

summary: Nifty 15,700→16,900 (+1,200 in five sessions) but an 'index management' rally: HDFC, HDFC Bank, Kotak, ICICI pumped; mid/small caps red; advance-decline negative. FII selling collapsed to 176 crore; DII bought 1,098 crore. He speculated LIC-type money entered at 15,700 and declared it the floor; turned bull again, holding 13,000-16,000 long-dated put ladders as stock positions.

events.claim: Nifty +1,200 points in five sessions to 16,900; ~25% of the day's rally from HDFC + HDFC Bank alone
FII selling fell to 176 crore (near-zero) on 14 Mar 2022 after weeks of thousands of crores
Advance-decline stayed negative through the rally - advance limited to ~4-7 heavyweight stocks (index management)

lessons: Narrow, index-managed rallies end badly for broad portfolios: check advance-decline and mid/small-cap participation before trusting the index.
Oversold bellwethers (HDFC complex, Bajaj Finance) snap back hardest once forced selling stops - the recovery leaders are the beaten leaders.

China index ~zero over 15 years as a long-bear warning. Peace talks resumed; support 16,700-16,750; 200-DMA ~16,900 gate.

events.claim: Brent crude fell ~30% from $130 to ~$100 within days (mid-Mar 2022)
FIIs sold only ~100 crore on 14 Mar 2022 - lowest in a month; net buyers on just two days since 1 Jan 2022 (each ~100 crore)
Hong Kong -40% from 52-week high (30,000→18,000); China's index roughly -40% over 15 years (6,000→3,000)
March series round trip: 17,100→15,700→16,900 (~2,600 points) in 2-3 weeks

Zero long-horizon returns happen in major markets (China, Hong Kong, UK examples) - 'long term' is not a strategy by itself.
In high VIX, keep positions light and intraday; positional views need VIX below ~25.

Fed meeting tomorrow; direction changing every half hour - 'trader's nightmare'.

Auto PLI list included Maruti Suzuki and Hero MotoCorp; auto stocks rose 3-4%
Brent crude fell below $100 intraday (15-16 Mar 2022)

US VIX closed below 30 on 15-16 Mar 2022 after an extended 30-38 range

Capitulation in one region's dominant sector (Chinese tech) creates read-through bounces in another's (Indian IT) - map the ownership, not the geography.

Alibaba +33% and Tencent +23% on 16 Mar 2022 after ~20%+ crashes - policy-easing reversal
Nifty futures crossed 17,000 at a large premium on 16 Mar 2022, exactly touching the 200-DMA

Markets can rally violently on no news amid war - positioning (short covering), not headlines, drove this leg; never assume news caused every move.
'Buy the rumor' can invert: a 1,000-point pre-Fed rally left the event itself as the risk.

summary: Fed hiked 25bp; Dow swung -600 then +600 in the final hour ahead of quadruple witching. SGX indicating ~17,300 (+300). events.claim: US Fed raised rates 25bp on 16 Mar 2022; Dow fell ~600 post-announcement then recovered ~600 in the last hour
Alibaba +33% and Tencent +23% on consecutive days; Hang Seng -11% over two days then +15% over the next two
Feb 24, 2022 expiry day: gap-up, then Nifty -800 and Bank Nifty -2,500 - the expiry-day lottery pattern

Russia reported launching hypersonic missiles in Ukraine (19-20 Mar 2022 weekend)

lessons: A 70-point futures premium with a week left in the series is a covering signature: such distortions mean the move is mechanical, not convictional - expect mean reversion of the basis.
In VIX ~24 regimes, ±400-500 point daily swings with no news are normal: trade the regime's size, not the news flow's narrative.
